title: Unobtainable Items
description: Unobtainable Items Drop With Silk Touch
body:
**The Unobtainable Items Pluggin!**

This plugin will allow users to get some blocks that are oftentimes unobtainable in normal minecraft.

This plugin is also customizable, giving the user the ability to customize whether or not the group of items is enabled, and the ability to define which minimum tool is required to break the item.

If you are interested in customizing the plugin, there is an info section on the config.yml file.

I hope you enjoy!

# Item Groups

The following item groups are:

- Dirt Variants: dirt_path, farmland
  
- Spawners: spawner, trial_spawner, vault
  
- Infested Stones: (all infested stone types)
  
- Suspicious Blocks: suspicious_sand, suspicious_gravel
  
- Reinforced Deepslate: reinforced_deepslate
  
- Amethyst: budding_amethyst
  
- Chorus Plant: chorus_plant
  
- Frog Eggs: frogspawn

# Commands

Admin are able to use /itemsettings to see these settings in game.
